name: Dr. GRPO
tagline: GRPO without standard-deviation normalization: subtract only the per-prompt group mean reward.
formula: $$s_i = \sum_t r_{i,t}, \quad \bar{s}_g = \frac{1}{|g|} \sum_{j \in g} s_j \\ A_i = (s_i - \bar{s}_g) \cdot M_i \quad \text{(broadcast to all response tokens)}$$
diff_from_baseline: Liu et al. 2025 — "Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective". Drops the std-normalization step from GRPO to remove length/variance bias; outcome-level group baseline only.

name: GRPO
tagline: Group Relative Policy Optimization: per-prompt group mean and std normalization of outcome rewards.
formula: $$s_i = \sum_t r_{i,t}, \quad \bar{s}_g = \frac{1}{|g|} \sum_{j \in g} s_j, \quad \sigma_g = \mathrm{std}(\{s_j\}_{j \in g}) \\ A_i = \frac{s_i - \bar{s}_g}{\sigma_g + \epsilon} \cdot M_i \quad \text{(broadcast to all response tokens)}$$
diff_from_baseline: Shao et al. 2024 (DeepSeekMath). Group-relative policy optimization: outcome-level z-score across multiple sampled responses per prompt; no value model needed.

name: REINFORCE++-baseline
tagline: Per-prompt group mean baseline followed by token-level batch whitening over valid response tokens.
pseudocode:
1. $s_i = \sum_t r_{i,t}$ (sum of token rewards).
2. $\bar{s}_g = \frac{1}{|g|} \sum_{j \in g} s_j$ (per-prompt group mean).
3. $\hat{s}_i = s_i - \bar{s}_g$ (group-centered).
4. Broadcast: $A_{i,t} = \hat{s}_i \cdot M_{i,t}$ (per-token).
5. Masked whiten across batch's valid tokens: $A \leftarrow \frac{A - \mu_M(A)}{\sigma_M(A) + \epsilon} \cdot M$.
6. Returns = advantages.
diff_from_baseline: Hu et al. 2025 (REINFORCE++, arxiv 2501.03262) — verl reference implementation in core_algos.py. Combines group-baseline with global token-level whitening; longer responses dominate whitening statistics.
